mechanism.claim: At the fixed UTC day boundary, a volatile completed day in which perpetual open interest and BTC price moved in opposite directions identifies inventory displacement rather than price-confirming position growth. When both realized variation and the absolute OI-price displacement are unusually large, price should reconcile toward the OI direction for twelve elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: sign of the completed 24-hour open-interest log return, opposite the price return
mechanism.why_distinct: DOPDR uses one fixed daily reconciliation observation, 24-hour OI and price log returns, and a realized-variation/displacement pair of causal ranks. OIDCR used a dense 30-minute four-hour state law; HVOPCR used hourly OI contraction and price continuation; RV20 used prior-calendar volatility with liquidation-transfer fields.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the signal requires completed-day realized variation above its own causal outer regime
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one 00:05 UTC daily reconciliation entry is sparse and absent from Gross9's activity clocks

clock.decision: exact 00:00 UTC boundary D after 24 consecutive source-valid completed hours [D-24h,D)
clock.price_return: log(last completed-hour close / first completed-hour open) over [D-24h,D), nonzero
clock.oi_return: log(OI_D/OI_D-24h) from positive raw-time backward-asof observations at both boundaries, each age<=5m, nonzero
clock.realized_variation: sqrt(sum of 24 squared completed-hour BTC log returns)
clock.causal_ranks: realized variation and displacement are each ranked against exactly the strictly prior 180 valid daily observations; at least 126 are required and current is excluded
clock.reservation: fixed daily decisions; global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only for later PnL

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.oi: reuse hash-bound OCDR-12C raw-time OI snapshot through 2026-08-01
source_plan.completed_price_hour: reuse hash-bound OICER completed-hour snapshot through 2026-08-01
source_plan.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent daily inventory-displacement mechanism and sparse clock chosen before incidence

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no threshold, side, hold, clock, or subset repair.
